notes: zmij::Buffer::new().format(x) on an f32. The harness narrows the f64 fixture to f32 (exact) before timing. The call returns the buffer and length; no String is built.
details: zmij::Buffer::new().format(x) on an f32. The fixture is read as f64 by the harness and narrowed to f32 (exact) before timing. The call returns the stack buffer and the written length; no String is built inside it.
